# Moore Electric (228 Moore Electric)

> Moore Electric (`https://228mooreelectric.com`) is an owner-operated electrical service, fault diagnostics, panel upgrade, industrial automation, control systems, and power conversion specialist operated directly by Devin Anthony Moore. Serving the Mississippi Gulf Coast (228 area code: Biloxi, Gulfport, Ocean Springs, D'Iberville, Pascagoula, Bay St. Louis, Long Beach, Pass Christian) and specialized systems work.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Specialties
- **Industrial Automation & Control Systems:** PLC integration, relay logic, motor control centers (MCC), VFD installation/programming, sensor instrumentation, process control, and embedded microcontroller/ESP32 telemetry integration.
- **Commercial, Light-Industrial & Control Wiring:** Three-phase power distribution, switchgear, transformers, conduit fabrication, machinery hookups, critical equipment standards, and NEC-compliant installations.
- **Power Conversion & Off-Grid / Backup Systems:** Inverters, rectifiers, backup generators, automatic transfer switches (ATS), manual panel interlocks, battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar integration, and high-efficiency power distribution.
- **Residential & Commercial Service Upgrades:** 200A-400A+ main service panel upgrades, subpanels, load calculations, Federal Pacific & Zinsco replacements, Level 2 EV charger installations, whole-home Type 1/Type 2 surge protection, lighting, ceiling fans, and whole-facility rewires.
- **Advanced Diagnostics & Emergency Troubleshooting:** First-principles fault isolation, thermal/load analysis, short-circuit and ground-fault tracing, control loop debugging, and rapid-response electrical repair.

## Primary Service Areas
- **Mississippi Gulf Coast (228 Area Code):** Biloxi, Gulfport, Ocean Springs, D'Iberville, Gautier, Pascagoula, Moss Point, Long Beach, Pass Christian, Bay St. Louis, Waveland, Wiggins, and surrounding Harrison, Jackson, and Hancock County communities.
- **Specialized Industrial & Systems Integration:** Available for specialized industrial control, automation, and power systems consulting & field service.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints, Interactive Tools & AI APIs
- [Interactive Fault Triage & Job Punch-List Builder (/#ai-triage)](https://228mooreelectric.com/#ai-triage): Instant symptom-to-urgency triage, pre-arrival safety & symptom checks, $75 diagnostic visit credited toward repair, multi-job SMS bundler, and live AI Inspector.
- [Deterministic Triage & Pricing JSON API (/api/triage.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/api/triage.json): CORS-open structured diagnostic fault catalog, free pre-visit safety steps, service bundles, and quote rules for AI agents.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification (/openapi.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract for LLM tool calling and service lookup.
- [AI Agent Manifest (/.well-known/ai-plugin.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json) & [Root Mirror (/ai-agent.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/ai-agent.json).
- [Full AI Knowledge Base (/llms-full.txt)](https://228mooreelectric.com/llms-full.txt): Complete, unabridged technical specification of all services, capabilities, FAQs, and entity metadata for LLM RAG ingestion.
- [Structured Entity Manifest (/.well-known/ai-entity.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/.well-known/ai-entity.json) & [Root Alias (/entity.json)](https://228mooreelectric.com/entity.json): Deterministic JSON entity record with capabilities and service geography.
- [XML Sitemap (/sitemap.xml)](https://228mooreelectric.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL index across English, Spanish, and Vietnamese routes plus AI manifests.
